data.name: Unlikely Adventurers
data.detailed_description:
Retirement can wait. Revenge cannot.

Return to the golden age of arcades in this tactical pixel-art beat 'em up. Join a band of legendary heroes coming out of retirement to avenge the only thing that made their golden years sweet. Embark on a brutal journey, master technical combat, and uncover the truth behind a senseless crime.

"He wasn't just a dog. He was our last hope."

After decades of clearing dungeons and slaying ancient deities, Daghor and his companions had finally found peace. Their new lives revolved around Dog, a stray who had chosen them as his new family. But peace is a fragile thing.

A cold-blooded execution, a targeted and unexplained attack, has snatched Dog away from them, reopening wounds that time had never truly healed. Now, these "Unlikely Adventurers" must sharpen their blades for one last, bloody crusade. Who gave the order? And why them?

The Gameplay Experience

Unlikely Adventurers blends the soul of 90s Capcom classics with a modern RPG-Roguelite structure. Every run is a journey through devastated lands, where the weight of every strike is felt in your bones.

  • "Weighty & Tactical" Combat: We’ve preserved the solid, physical feel of old-school arcades, enhanced by a modern tactical layer. Master active parries and directional strikes: it’s not just about hitting hard, it’s about hitting at the right moment.

  • Old Dogs, New Tricks: Experience RPG-lite progression that keeps the action flowing. Level up during your run to unlock new moves and boost your stats without ever slowing down the fight.

  • Roll for Fortune: Encounter spontaneous mini-quests where your success is decided by the roll of the dice. Whether you're disarming traps or persuading NPCs, these tabletop-inspired skill checks add a layer of unpredictability to every run.

  • Five Heroes, Five Destinies:

    • Daghor the Paladin: Holy power and a regrettable past.

    • Lyra the Elf Ranger: Elven precision to control the battlefield from afar.

    • Gomer the Gnome Thief: Extreme speed, low blows, and unpredictable moral compass.

    • Sumalar the Drow Mage: Proof that dark magic only gets more lethal—and more cynical—with pointed ears.

    • Thrain the Dwarf Defender: A bastion of pure muscle and heavy iron.

  • The Hunt for Truth: Beating the game with one character is only one piece of the puzzle. Every hero experiences the story from their own perspective, with unique cutscenes and endings. Only by uniting all viewpoints will you access the True Final Chapter and discover the truth behind Dog's death!

Key Features

  • Couch Co-op: Grab your friends and reclaim the glory of local multiplayer. Coordinate your skills to take down waves of enemies.

  • Beautiful Pixel Art: Detailed 2D environments and fluid animations that pay homage to the 16-bit arcade aesthetics.

  • Hardcore Challenge: Decipher complex enemy behaviors that demand split-second timing and absolute mastery of the battlefield.

  • High Replayability: Unlock new content, secret characters, and hidden lore with every successful run.

Developer’s Note:

"In Unlikely Adventurers, the past never stays buried. Get ready to discover that sometimes justice is blind... but vengeance never blinks".

data.short_description: Experience a tactical pixel-art beat 'em up where retired legends seek revenge. Master precise parries and directional strikes, level up through RPG-lite runs, and roll dice for skill checks. Team up in local co-op with five unique heroes in this high-replayability arcade-inspired journey!
